extras: Requires manual installation by copying the plugin folder into the vault.
intentEvidence: Right-click any card in an Obsidian Canvas and choose "Copy card info" to copy that card's data to your clipboard.
problem: Users need an easy way to extract structured data from specific canvas elements for external use or organization.
summary: A utility that allows users to right-click any card on an Obsidian Canvas and copy its detailed information, including type, ID, position, and size, to the clipboard.
